name: ismylmohammad.com — Data Engineering Voice Ops Agent (ETL Incident, Databricks, pgvector & Lineage)

parameters.content:
## Pipeline 1: ETL / Schema Drift / Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) Alert -> Outbound Voice Commander
Receives real-time alerts from **Databricks Jobs**, **PostgreSQL / pgvector pipelines**, **dbt / Great Expectations data quality checks**, or **n8n Error Trigger / DLQ** (`POST /webhook/de-pipeline-alert`).
Analyzes blast radius & downstream DAMA lineage impact, logs the incident in PostgreSQL, and triggers an immediate **Vapi.ai** outbound call to Ismyl (`+91 83601 93921`) or the Data Steward to remediate by voice.

nodes.name: Normalize Incident & Compute Lineage Blast Radius
PostgreSQL — Log Data Incident & Lineage Impact

parameters.content:
## Pipeline 2: Live Mid-Call Data Engineering Tool Server (`POST /webhook/de-vapi-tools`)
Executes spoken engineering commands in real time while you are on the call:
1. `trigger_databricks_or_dlq_replay`: Triggers a Databricks job retry (`POST /api/2.1/jobs/run-now`) or replays rows from the PostgreSQL Dead-Letter Queue.
2. `quarantine_corrupt_batch`: Moves corrupt/drifted rows to `quarantine_batches` with a **SHA-256 provenance hash** and unblocks the main ETL pipeline.
3. `query_pipeline_health_and_lineage`: Queries live PostgreSQL / pgvector freshness, row counts, and DAMA lineage owners.

nodes.name: Databricks API — Trigger Job & Replay DLQ

parameters.query:
UPDATE de_pipeline_incidents SET
  status = 'QUARANTINED_AND_UNBLOCKED',
  remediation_action = 'Quarantined {{ $json.arguments.dlq_row_count || 0 }} drifted rows; main pipeline unblocked by steward voice command.',
  resolved_at = NOW()
WHERE incident_id = '{{ $json.arguments.incident_id }}';

nodes.name: PostgreSQL — Query Live Pipeline & Lineage Status

parameters.content:
## Pipeline 3: Post-Call DAMA Provenance Ledger & RCA Dispatcher (`POST /webhook/de-vapi-eoc`)
Captures the end-of-call report, generates a **SHA-256 cryptographic provenance hash** of the engineer's voice authorization + transcript, updates PostgreSQL (`de_pipeline_incidents`), and dispatches an automated **Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Lineage Audit Summary** via **Gmail** (`ismylconnect@gmail.com`).

parameters.query:
UPDATE de_pipeline_incidents SET
  status = 'RESOLVED_VIA_VOICE_OPS',
  voice_rca_summary = '{{ $json.summary }}',
  recording_url = '{{ $json.recording_url }}',
  sha256_provenance = '{{ $json.sha256_decision_hash }}',
  resolved_at = NOW()
WHERE incident_id = '{{ $json.incident_id }}';
